source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
As [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, pick which Combat Drugs your army has active until [your next Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), in one of 2 ways:

- pick a single drug from the list, though no drug can be picked this way a second time in the battle
- roll 2D6 to pick 2 drugs at random; these can repeat drugs picked before, but a drug that is already active adds nothing more

Each drug, by its D6 result, affects your **WYCH CULT** models:

- **Adrenalight** (1): their melee weapons get +1 A.
- **Hypex** (2): they get +2" M.
- **Serpentin** (3): their melee weapons get +1 WS.
- **Painbringer** (4): they get +1 T.
- **Grave Lotus** (5): their melee weapons get +1 S.
- **Splintermind** (6): they get +1 Ld, and their ranged weapons get +1 BS.
